name: sharepoint-copilot-agents-and-skills
description: Authors, deploys, verifies, backs up and restores SharePoint Copilot agents (.agent packages and templates) and native SKILL.md skills in a tenant's AgentAssets library. Authoring is zero tenant I/O; deploy, restore and undeploy are dry-run by default, with writes gated behind -Execute (restore and undeploy also require an exact confirmation); library provisioning is the exception and writes immediately when run.
